subject: Deployment mode follow-up: HIPAA, SOC 2, and BAA requirements
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Smith <jamie.smith@elarahealth.com>
Cc: sec_ops@elarahealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode options and compliance next steps

Hi Jamie —

Great to meet you and the Elara team today. Quick post-call recap + proposed next steps to keep the evaluation moving: 

Recap
- Use case: clinical triage assistant + de-identified note summarization for care teams.
- Primary requirements: HIPAA compliance (BAA), SOC 2 Type II evidence, audit logs and access controls, data residency in US.
- Desired latency profile: sub-second for single-turn generation; throughput for batch summarization.

Deployment options we discussed
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-managed; SOC 2 + standard security controls; supports BAA via signed agreement; shared compute (multi-tenant) — lowest time-to-prod.
2) Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools; predictable throughput and tenant isolation; can be SOC 2 scoped and we can offer stricter network controls.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer-controlled network and keys; recommended when audit/audit-trail separation or strict egress controls are required.

What we need from Elara to recommend a deployment path
- Confirmation whether you require a signed BAA for initial pilot (yes/no)
- Whether SOC 2 Type II evidence is sufficient or if you need the current audit to be scoped to dedicated infrastructure
- Any additional audit requirements (e.g., async access to raw request logs for your auditors, retention windows)

Attached: Redwood_Security_Pack_v2.pdf (SOC 2 overview, encryption & keys, audit logs), Draft_BAA_Elara_Redwood.docx (editable), SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf (redacted).

Suggested next steps
1) Please confirm BAA requirement and primary procurement contact.
2) If you prefer a technical deep-dive on Dedicated vs Private, we can schedule a 60-min session with our solutions engineer (Marissa) and infra lead (Dylan).
3) Share any procurement timelines/PO templates.

Thanks — I'll wait for confirmation and can loop Marissa/Dylan as needed.
—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jamie Smith <jamie.smith@elarahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@elarahealth.com>, Security Ops <sec_ops@elarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode options and compliance next steps

Thanks Neha — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do require a signed BAA for the pilot. Procurement will need a redline-able copy (we've attached our procurement request template).
- SOC 2 Type II report is good; however, our security team needs confirmation that the report and controls cover the Dedicated offering. If Dedicated is not fully scoped in your public SOC 2, we may require SOC evidence scoped to Dedicated or a compensating control plan.
- We will need access to detailed audit logs (request/response metadata, timestamps, and user IDs) retained for at least 2 years for audit purposes.
- Preferred path: we are open to Dedicated for initial pilot if pricing and timeline work; Private VPC is a possibility but may take longer to provision.

Can you confirm: typical lead time to provision Dedicated capacity and high-level pricing bands? Also loop in Marissa/Dylan for a technical session next week.

Jamie
Jamie Smith
Head of Platform Integrations
Elara Health
jamie.smith@elarahealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Elara follow-up — HIPAA/BAA + SOC2 scoping (need pricing/timeline)

Marissa / Dylan — forwarding Jamie's reply from Elara. TL;DR: they require a signed BAA for the pilot, SOC 2 evidence scoped to Dedicated if possible, audit logs retained for 2 years, and they are open to Dedicated for the pilot.

Requests: 
- Marissa: can you confirm whether our SOC 2 Type II report covers Dedicated capacity (and if not, what the timeline/approach is to provide scoped evidence)?
- Dylan: typical lead time to provision Dedicated GPU pool (1-2 nodes for pilot) and ballpark pricing bands for monthly reserved capacity + burst. Also note any network/egress controls needed for Elara.

I'll prepare the procurement contact and send Draft_BAA (attached) once we have pricing.

Thanks — Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Elara follow-up — HIPAA/BAA + SOC2 scoping (need pricing/timeline)

Thanks Neha — quick notes from the solutions/infra side: 

SOC 2 scoping:
- Our public SOC 2 Type II report (attached SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf) covers hosted and dedicated offerings that are part of Redwood's managed deployment. Dedicated Reserved Pools provisioned in Redwood Dedicated are within scope of our control environment; we can provide an SOC 2 letter of attestation confirming that the Dedicated capacity is included in the scope. If Elara requires auditor access or a customer-specific scope, we usually provide a compensating-control plan and can assess time/cost to onboard Dedicated into a customer-scoped attestation.

Audit logs / retention:
- We can provide request/response metadata (no PII/PHI in logs by default) and support customizable retention policies. For HIPAA workloads we can enable extended retention (up to 24 months) plus secure export for audits. We will need to define retention storage and access controls in the BAA/contract.

Provisioning & pricing (pilot estimate):
- Lead time: 7-14 business days to provision a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent GPUs) once contract signed and account set up.
- Pricing band (pilot): $40k- $70k/month reserved depending on GPU class and burst policy; we can offer a 3-month pilot commit discount.
- Private/VPC: multi-week lead time and additional engineering integration for on-prem or air-gapped. Higher initial setup costs.

Next steps I can support:
- Join a technical deep-dive to walk through audit log fields, retention controls, and network architecture.
- Provide a short attestation letter for Dedicated scoping.



Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode options and compliance next steps

Jamie — thanks for the quick response and context. Per Marissa/Dylan's notes below: 

- BAA: attaching Draft_BAA_Elara_Redwood.docx for your procurement team to review and redline.
- SOC 2: attaching SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf and we'll provide a Dedicated-scoping attestation letter; please confirm if that suffices for your security team or whether they want customer-specific scope.
- Audit logs / retention: we can support 24-month retention and secure export for audits; we'll capture this in the BAA.
- Provisioning & pricing: pilot lead time ~7-14 business days after contract; ballpark pilot pricing $40k- $70k/month (we can provide a formal quote once you share desired GPU class and burst policy). We can also discuss a 3-month pilot discount.

Next steps: 
1) Procurement: please confirm primary PO/procurement contact and upload any PO templates (we received your procurement request attachment).
2) Security: would you like an internal-only technical deep-dive first or a joint session with procurement + security? We can schedule next week — available slots: Tue 4/6 10-11am PT or Wed 4/7 2-3pm PT.
3) I'll follow up with a short Dedicated attestation letter and a formal pilot quote once you confirm target GPU class.

Looking forward —
